resources.string: Encrypted snapshot of all 19 domain tables, including meals, foods, workouts, scale composition and the new Xiaomi archive. Credentials, preferences, media and sync cursors are excluded. Maximum decoded archive: 32 MiB. Physical phone-transfer testing is still required.
